title: Normalized scalar reconstruction with a fixed internal adjunction
statement: For a site with internal modules and their section reconstruction [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], a coefficient morphism and its section map [def-sfb-section-scalar-map-data], and a fixed internal derived scalar extension adjoint to exact restriction [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars], define ScalarTransport to consist of the actual universal normalized section scalar pair [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data], an ordinary restriction isomorphism that is identity on every underlying section, and an extension comparison whose inverse mate under the two specified adjunctions is precisely localization of that restriction square [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. restrictionComparison is that exact localization, with its canonical composition comparisons. scalarTransport specializes this data to the actual pulled-back coefficients on a scheme [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. The extension, adjunction and computation-counit aliases retain those fixed internal universal constructions. The general scalar-adjunction normalization is the predicate [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-adjunction-data].
